description:
# Pocketgull Clinical Decision & Biophysical Benchmark

## Overview & Purpose
This dataset provides de-identified 3D volumetric metadata, multi-label diagnostic annotations, and synthetic clinical consult vectors engineered for Pocketgull's clinical decision support engine, evaluating diagnostic accuracy, Popperian falsifiability ($p < 0.05$), and Socratic evidence literacy.

## Data Provenance & Sources
- Source: Pocketgull Clinical Decision Intelligence Engine & Biophysical Archive
- Pipeline: De-identified via HIPAA §164.514(b)(2) Safe Harbor standards

## Files & Schema
- `train.csv`: 4,400+ study-level multi-label pathology annotations.
- `train_series.csv`: DICOM MRI volumetric acquisition parameters and plane orientations.
- `train_labels_gemini.csv`: Gemini distilled weak labels with clinical rationale confidence scores.

## HIPAA Safe Harbor Compliance
Strictly compliant with HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(b)(2) Safe Harbor anonymization. All 18 direct personal identifiers (names, dates, MRNs, institutional headers) have been permanently removed.
